scene1_screen1.text: She wasn’t supposed to be here. Not in this room. Not in this body that still aches from piano benches and late-night rehearsals.

scene1_screen2.text: But today, she needed something different. Something that moved. Something that burned.

scene1_screen3.text: Lesley pushes open the studio door. Just slightly. Just enough to slip in quietly.

scene1_screen5.text: Too late. Heads turn. Muscles freeze. Eyes narrow. And at the center of the room — him.

scene1_screen6.text: Mr. Light. Legend. Prodigy. Infamous for both choreography… and complications. His gaze meets hers like a spotlight — calm, but unblinking.

scene1_screen8.text: He says it without raising his voice. But the entire studio goes still.

scene1_screen9.text: (gentle, almost breathless) Sorry. I got lost…

scene1_screen10.text: (cutting in) Four minutes. We count them here. In music. In motion. Not excuses.

scene1_screen11.text: She stands straighter. Tries to smile. It doesn’t work.

scene1_screen13.text: (small nod) Yes. I just thought — I wanted to try something else.

scene1_screen14.text: So you wandered into the most demanding room on campus?

scene1_screen15.text: She flushes. His tone should sting. But something in it — amusement? Interest? — Keeps her rooted.

scene1_screen16.text: (steps closer) Music isn’t the only way to bleed. You’ll find that out soon enough.

scene1_screen17.text: He turns on his heel. Graceful. Controlled. Then claps sharply.

scene1_screen19.text: The class obeys instantly. She scrambles to find a space near the back. Her heart races. Not just from nerves. From him.

scene1_screen20.text: He moves like a storm behind glass — too powerful for the room that contains him. Every correction he gives cuts clean. Every glance burns.

scene1_screen21.text: Lesley follows the steps. Tries to disappear. But he sees her. All the time.

scene1_screen22.text: A half-turn. Her arm falters, he's suddenly there — close.

scene1_screen24.text: His hand slides along her back, down to her waist.

scene1_screen26.text: He adjusts her slowly. Intimately. His fingers were warm through the thin fabric. The studio blurs. Only their reflections remain — his body guiding hers.

scene1_screen27.text: He doesn’t say more. He doesn’t need to. The rest of the class disappears into tempo and tension. But her skin still remembers the exact pressure of his touch.

scene1_screen28.text: When the final notes fade, students begin to pack up — chattering, sweaty, alive. Lesley lingers. Mr. Light is writing something in his notebook, his back turned. She takes a step toward him and stops.

scene1_screen29.text: Their eyes meet in the mirror. Hers full of hesitation. His unreadable. But not unfeeling.

scene1_screen31.text: She lowers her gaze. Shoulders tense. Then turns, quietly slipping away. He watches her go. Eyes on the curve of her neck, the way she hesitates just before leaving the class.

scene1_choice1.text: What do you do with the impression she left behind?

scene1_choice1_option1_screen1.text: He closes the notebook. Taps his pen against the cover.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (internal) Another student. That’s all. Talented? Yes. Trouble? Probably.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen3.text: But still… He watches the empty door for far too long.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen1.text: He writes her name in the corner of the attendance list. Then underlines it.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (internal) She learns with her body faster than most do with their minds. Not just musical. Responsive. That kind of instinct… Can’t be taught.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen1.text: The way she looked at him. The way she shivered when he touched her. Not fear. Anticipation.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen2.text: (internal) She doesn’t even know what she’s asking for. But I do.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen3.text: He lets himself imagine her staying behind. The studio. The silence. His hands on hers — guiding. Testing. Unraveling.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen4.text: He closes his eyes. Just for a second. And he wants.

scene1_screen32.text: Outside the studio, the world moves on. But inside, the echo of something new still hangs in the air. And neither of them will forget it.

scene2_screen1.text: A cozy café just off campus hums with indie music and the scent of coffee and cinnamon. Warm light spills over wooden tables where students linger.

scene2_screen2.text: Leslie sits near the window, notebook open, half-full cappuccino cooling beside her. She’s been staring at the same sentence for twenty minutes.

scene2_screen3.text: Her fingers tap the table — a quiet rhythm. Not piano keys. Not choreography. Just nerves.

scene2_screen4.text: She’s thinking about yesterday’s class. About the way his voice sounded when he corrected her. The way his hand moved — just slightly — along her hip.

scene2_screen5.text: (muttering, shaking her head) Get a grip, Les. It was just a dance class. Just choreography.

scene2_screen6.text: Then — the bell over the café door rings. She glances up.

scene2_screen7.text: He enters like he owns the room. Dark coat, undone scarf, coffee-black eyes scanning the space — until they land on her. Her breath catches.

scene2_screen8.text: (murmurs) No way. Not here. Not now.

scene2_screen9.text: He smiles. Just barely. Then walks toward her. She tries to look busy, but fails.

scene2_screen10.text: (teasing, low) Shoulders. Straighten. You’re collapsing your spine again.

scene2_screen11.text: His fingers brush her back. Just a touch — but it shoots down her spine like a shiver.

scene2_screen12.text: He pulls out the chair opposite hers.

scene2_screen14.text: (barely audible) No. I mean — yes. I mean… sure. Sit.

scene2_screen15.text: He sits. Legs crossed. Relaxed. She tries to breathe like a normal person. They sit for a beat. Then another. She finally looks up.

scene2_screen17.text: I teach. I drink coffee. I wander. Not always in that order.

scene2_screen19.text: (sipping) You’re in the music program, aren’t you?

scene2_screen20.text: Yeah. Piano. Composition. But… I signed up for dance to try something new. Shake things up.

scene2_screen21.text: (softly) Seems like you’re already doing that.

scene2_screen22.text: Silence stretches. Then he leans in, just a little.

scene2_screen23.text: You strike me as someone who doesn’t have much time for dating. (beat) Am I wrong?

scene2_screen24.text: She freezes. Words jam in her throat.

scene2_screen25.text: (stumbling) I — um. No. I mean… I’m not sure that’s relevant.

scene2_screen26.text: (grinning) Just conversation. You seem… thoughtful. Curious.

scene2_screen27.text: Before she can answer, a shadow looms. The dean of student affairs — gray suit, gray stare — stops at their table.

scene2_screen28.text: (frowning) Mr. Light, good afternoon. Having coffee with a student?

scene2_screen29.text: Silence. Lesley lowers her eyes. Her fingers tighten around the handle of her cup. Mr. Light’s jaw tenses, but he stays perfectly still — like he’s danced through worse.

scene2_screen30.text: (to Lesley) This isn’t how mentorship works.

scene2_screen31.text: Her cheeks flushed deep red. She feels the heat crawl up her neck, it’s panic.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen1.text: I was actually asking about private lessons.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (faster) Dance. One-on-one instruction. I just started, and I thought extra practice might help me keep up with the rest of the group.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen4.text: There’s a long pause. Then the dean chuckles.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen5.text: (dry) Well. One prodigy teaches another. Carry on. Just… keep it professional.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen6.text: He walks off. Mr. Light watches him go.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen7.text: (smirking) You didn’t have to rescue me. You really want a private lesson?

scene2_choice1_option1_screen8.text: (quietly) Maybe I just wanted more time.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen9.text: He leans in — closer than appropriate.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen10.text: (low) Next Thursday. 6 PM. Studio 3. Wear something you can sweat in.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen11.text: He touches her hand — just a brush — then rises and leaves without another word. She doesn’t move. Just exhales — like she’s been holding her breath since yesterday.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Leslie’s lips part — but no sound comes out. The silence says enough.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen3.text: (to the Dean) I was just leaving. Thank you for the reminder.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen4.text: The dean nods stiffly and moves on.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen5.text: Mr. Light looks down at her, something unreadable in his expression.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen7.text: (soft) I didn’t want to make it worse.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen9.text: He steps back. But before he turns to go:

scene2_choice1_option2_screen10.text: Private lesson. Next week. Of course, if you want.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen11.text: And then he’s gone. Leaving her heartbeat scattered like piano keys.

scene2_screen32.text: She stays there long after he’s gone. Coffee´s gone cold. Thoughts burning. Thursday can’t come soon enough.

scene2_screen33.text: (internal, barely a whisper to herself) What the hell am I getting into?

scene3_screen1.text: Lesley is early. Too early. And yet… not early enough to steady her breath.

scene3_screen2.text: She stands alone in the quiet studio, tying her hair up, her fingers slightly trembling. Her body is wrapped in a black training set — snug, sculpting.

scene3_screen3.text: (to herself, softly) Relax. It’s just practice. Just dance.

scene3_screen4.text: She begins to stretch. Her spine curves, her arms reach. Each motion is deliberate — not just to warm up. It’s a performance for him. She doesn’t see him yet — but in her mind, he’s already there. Correcting a line. Guiding a step.

scene3_screen5.text: She moves into the combination from the first class. Steps. Turn. Breath. Extend. Her movements are fluid, focused — but her mind isn’t entirely in the room. It’s ahead of her. Watching.

scene3_screen6.text: And from the doorway, someone is watching. Mr. Light stands just outside the threshold, silent, unmoving. His eyes follow the rhythm of her motion as if trying to solve a question only she can answer.

scene3_screen7.text: (internal, tight) What are you doing to me?

scene3_screen8.text: His breath hitches. His jaw tightens. She’s not a student right now. She’s something else. Something dangerous. Something beautiful.

scene3_screen9.text: He knows he should announce himself. But he doesn't. Not yet.

scene3_choice1.text: How do you respond to Leslie’s dance?

opts.text: Let her unknowingly perform for you.
Correct her technique with a professional touch.
Join her in the dance — make her feel what a real partner does.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen1.text: He leans against the frame, arms crossed. She doesn’t know he’s there and keeps dancing.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Her rhythm falters once, and she presses her palm to her chest, frustrated.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (to herself, exhaling) Les, focus! No one is watching. Why are you so nervous?

scene3_choice1_option1_screen4.text: He smiles faintly. That vulnerability — that softness — only adds to the tension winding through him.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen5.text: She spins, and her top lifts slightly, revealing the small of her back. His fingers twitch. He shouldn’t want. But he does.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen6.text: He steps forward when she finishes. Her breath is fast. She finally notices him — and it startles her.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen7.text: (startled) Oh—! (then quieter) How long were you…

scene3_choice1_option1_screen9.text: She doesn’t. Not for a second. Not with his eyes like that on her.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen1.text: He approaches her. No hesitation. She turns, startled — but doesn’t step away.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (low) You’re leading too early. Let me fix it.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen4.text: He places his hands on her hips. Adjusts the angle. Her breath catches. His fingers press, guiding — a little firmer than necessary.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen5.text: He moves behind her. His palm presses to her lower back, adjusting her posture. Their bodies don’t touch… but they almost do.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen6.text: He shifts her arm, then her shoulder. Her chest rises. Her lips part.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen8.text: (near her ear) Closer. You should feel, Lesley. Don’t repeat. Don’t perform. Let it happen through you.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen9.text: And she does. She closes her eyes. And surrenders.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen5.text: He leads her into the movement. Their bodies sync — spine to spine, wrist to wrist. Every move ripples between them. Her breath becomes his.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen6.text: She turns, and his arm wraps around her waist. His thigh brushes hers. She trembles.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen7.text: (soft) This is a duet now. Don’t think. Move with me.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen8.text: And she does. The dance turns intimate. Fluid. Close. Controlled only by tension.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen9.text: When they finish, she’s flushed, trembling. So is he.

scene3_screen10.text: The attraction between them is so strong that it feels like it pulsates through the entire room.

scene3_screen11.text: He looks at her. She looks at him. The mirror reflects them both — her in front, him behind. He steps closer.

scene3_screen12.text: (low, near her ear) Look at us.

scene3_screen15.text: His hand moves, slow and assured, tracing a path from her waist downward — not rushed, not demanding. Her breath catches.

scene3_screen17.text: Her reflection trembles, eyes searching her own face — and his behind her. His touch remains light, not claiming, but asking.

scene3_screen20.text: She leans into the moment — into him — her breath uneven. One hand grips the barre, the other pressing against the mirror for balance.

scene3_screen21.text: He watches — not just her body, but her surrender. The way tension leaves her shoulders. The way her expression softens into something unguarded, something real.

scene3_screen22.text: No words. No rush. Just a rhythm shared in silence — building, cresting, grounding. And when stillness returns, it’s thick with meaning.

scene3_screen24.text: Her fingers hover at her lips — as if trying to hold the moment in place. She takes a step back. Then another. Meets his eyes — wide, unsure, glowing. Then she grabs her things and slips out the door, her breath still uneven.

scene3_screen25.text: In the hallway, she leans against the wall. Her legs were trembling. Her fingers curl around the strap of her bag like it’s the only real thing.

scene3_screen26.text: (internal) This wasn’t supposed to happen. But I don’t want it to stop…

scene3_screen27.text: Inside, Mr. Light doesn’t move. Doesn’t breathe. Because for the first time, Sean Light isn’t sure if he just crossed the line… Or found something worth never stepping back from.

scene4_screen1.text: Lesley sits at the piano, fingers moving slowly over the keys. Not performing — searching. Every note is softer than it should be. A thought, not a declaration.

scene4_screen2.text: She hasn’t seen him in days. Not since that night. That dance. That mirror. The way his breath caught when hers did.

scene4_screen3.text: (whispers and cracks a bitter smile) He vanished after touching me like that. Classy.

scene4_screen4.text: She thought she’d feel guilty. Regret. But instead, there was… desire and fear about how they would meet next. A low hum behind her ribs. A longing that won’t quiet.

scene4_screen5.text: The door creaks open behind her. She doesn’t turn — but the scent hits her first. Clean, familiar, like tension and memory woven into cologne.

scene4_screen6.text: His reflection appears on the glossy black of the piano’s lid. Hair tousled. Eyes shadowed. A slight flush in his cheeks. He’s been drinking. Not much. Just enough to dim his edges.

scene4_screen7.text: (quietly) I couldn't find you for a few days — neither at the university nor at the coffee shop. I should have started looking in the music classes.

scene4_screen8.text: (softly, without turning) I didn’t think you’d want to see me.

scene4_screen9.text: He steps closer. Each movement was measured. Careful. Like she’s fragile glass. But her heartbeat is anything but.

scene4_screen10.text: I’ve been a lot of things. Angry. Confused. But I’ve never — I didn’t want to hurt you.

scene4_screen11.text: His voice falters. A first. She hears it. Feels it.

opts.text: Speak with honesty, keep it composed.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Lesley stands. Slowly. She doesn’t say anything — just steps close. Her arms find his waist. Her head rests against his chest.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen2.text: His breath hitches. His arms come around her, hesitant at first. Then firmer. Needing.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen4.text: (softly) You didn’t. You just… made it harder to breathe.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen5.text: They hold each other. Not for forgiveness, but for grounding, for the quiet.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen1.text: She turns to him — steady. Composed. But her fingers tremble on the edge of the piano.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen2.text: I didn’t know what that meant to you. I still don’t. But it meant something to me. And I’m not pretending it didn’t.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen3.text: He looks at her. Really looks. And nods — once.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen4.text: (quietly) It meant everything. That’s the problem.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen5.text: They stand close, but not touching. The air between them charged, unresolved, intimate in its restraint.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Leslie keeps playing — light, suggestive, a lazy melody. Her voice comes low, with a smile tucked inside it.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen2.text: You’re dramatic when you drink. But I think I like it.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen3.text: He blinks. Then smirks — a flicker of the man she remembers.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen4.text: (dry) You have no idea what I’m like when I’m actually drunk.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen6.text: She glances up. Their eyes meet in the reflection. The tension crackles.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen8.text: Only because I remember exactly how you responded to my rhythm.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen9.text: He leans down — close, but doesn’t kiss her.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen10.text: Careful. I might ask for another lesson.

scene4_screen12.text: The moment softens. The air cools. She shifts on the bench.

scene4_screen13.text: Want me to teach you something?

scene4_screen16.text: She guides his hands to the keys — slow, gentle.

scene4_screen17.text: Her fingers glide over his — mapping, leading, teasing. He follows. His breath is uneven. The music is clumsy. But the contact? Perfect.

scene4_screen19.text: I think you just stole my lead.

scene4_screen21.text: They sit like that for a few more moments — tangled in melody and tension.

scene4_screen23.text: I have a class. But I’ll see you soon.

scene4_screen24.text: He watches her go. Doesn’t move.

scene4_screen26.text: (from the doorway) Come to the Fountain Square. There’s a performance. And I want you there.

scene4_screen27.text: She disappears. But her presence lingers. Like the last note of a love song — echoing.

scene5_screen1.text: Lesley adjusts the bench. Fingers hover above the keys. She’s not nervous. Not really. But something inside her pulses.

scene5_screen2.text: He said he would come. She doesn’t know if he will. Part of her hopes he won’t. The rest is dying for him to appear.

scene5_screen3.text: (calming whisper, to herself) Stop looking for him... Just play, Les.

scene5_screen4.text: She takes a breath. Presses the first note. Then the second. And the music begins to spill like wine — slow, heady, red with longing.

scene5_screen5.text: Every part of her is focused. And yet — the minute he arrives, she feels it. Mr. Light moves through the crowd like he belongs to another tempo entirely. Slower. Surer. Eyes only on her.

scene5_screen6.text: (whispering to himself) There you are. God, look at you.

scene5_screen7.text: Her pulse skips. Her thighs tighten against the piano bench. She doesn’t miss a note — but her body reacts like a memory has just brushed her skin.

scene5_screen8.text: He doesn’t interrupt. He watches. Watches her mouth part with each exhale. Watches her hips shift to the rhythm. Watches her play not for the crowd — but for him.

scene5_screen9.text: (internal) You’re not performing. You’re… giving yourself up to the keys. And to me.

scene5_screen10.text: She feels owned by the air. By his eyes. By what happened between them. And by what still buzzes between them now.

opts.text: Watch, let her have the spotlight.
Pull her aside after the show.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen1.text: He steps into the open space. Quietly. Confidently. The crowd hushes. The moment charges.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (internal) If she’s playing for me, then I’ll move for her.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Without speaking, he moves to her music — one slow step, then another. Every motion is  deliberate. Controlled. Sensual.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen4.text: He doesn’t just dance with the music. He dances for her. Matching her crescendos with body rolls. She pauses with stillness. His hips sway. His chest rises and falls in sync with her phrasing.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen5.text: The crowd forgets to clap. They just stare — because something raw and real is unfolding between two people who forgot the world was watching.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen6.text: (whisper, to herself) God. This is insane. And I don’t want it to stop.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen7.text: Their eyes meet mid-performance. And something passes between them like flame on silk. She plays harder. Faster. He follows — a storm tethered to her tempo.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen8.text: By the final note, she’s breathless. And he’s only inches from her.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen9.text: (quietly) Next time… you play for me. In private.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen10.text: (smiling, flushed) Only if you dance for me again.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen11.text: He bows to the crowd — but his gaze never leaves her. And neither does hers.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen1.text: He stays in the crowd. Still. Focused. A silent pillar among murmurs and motion.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen2.text: His eyes never leave her hands. He tracks each phrase like it’s his breath on the line.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen3.text: She feels him watching. She knows. And somehow, it makes her bolder. She closes her eyes, lets her back arch, lets the music swell with longing.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen4.text: When the final chord lands, she looks up — and finds his gaze waiting.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen6.text: He lifts two fingers in a silent, almost reverent salute. She nods — barely. But her cheeks are flushed, and her breath shallow.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen7.text: He didn’t even have to touch me for me to feel like I´m on fire.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen8.text: Sometimes devotion is quiet. But no less intense.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen1.text: He doesn’t move until the applause starts. Then he slips through the crowd, slow and sure. When he reaches her, she’s still at the bench — glowing with adrenaline.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen3.text: She laughs — breathless, a little shaken.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen5.text: You played like you hoped I would.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen6.text: (eyes locking with his) Maybe I did.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen7.text: He reaches out — brushes a strand of hair from her cheek. His fingers graze skin. A touch too soft. Too intimate for a crowd. But she doesn’t flinch.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen8.text: (low) Come find me. There’s a rhythm I haven’t taught you yet.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen9.text: He turns — disappears into the crowd. But her body hums like a struck chord.

scene5_screen11.text: The square slowly empties. But Lesley stays, heart thudding. Her fingers still tingle from the keys. Her thighs still tremble from his gaze.

scene5_screen12.text: Tonight wasn’t a performance. It was a prelude.

scene6_screen1.text: A few days later. The same dance studio and only a teacher in it...

scene6_screen2.text: Mr. Light stands at the center of the room, his breath slow, his posture steady — but only outwardly. Inside, he's burning. The room is quiet, but not empty. Not anymore.

scene6_screen3.text: The door creaks. Soft footsteps echo. He knows them by heart. Leslie walks in. The shadows cling to her frame for a moment before she steps into the light — no longer hesitant. Just… real. Poised. And a little scared.

scene6_screen4.text: I didn’t think I’d feel this nervous.

scene6_screen6.text: She nods. Her eyes flick to the mirror. Then to him.

scene6_screen7.text: I had to know what this was.

scene6_screen8.text: He crosses to the speaker. A low rhythm begins — smoky jazz, intimate and slow. He reaches out his hand. She takes it.

scene6_screen9.text: They dance. But not like before. This isn’t about the steps. It’s about the space between them.

scene6_screen10.text: The air was charged with everything unsaid. Every time his palm brushes her waist, every time her breath catches when his fingertips graze her back — it builds.

scene6_screen11.text: A conversation written in proximity. In movement. In tension. They stop. Barely apart. Hearts beat loudly. Eyes locked.

opts.text: Break the rules, kiss him hard!
Stay close, suggest a deeper connection.
Walk away, not forever — just for now.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Lesley takes a single step forward — slow, intentional. Her chest rises and falls with unsteady breath as she looks up at him, her eyes darker than he’s ever seen.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (quietly) I’m done pretending this is just a dance.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen3.text: She reaches for his hand — not to hold it, but to press it flat over her sternum. Her skin is hot beneath his fingers, her heartbeat frantic.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen6.text: Their faces are close now. Not touching — but the space between them crackles. Her hand glides up his arm, slow and reverent, until it rests at his shoulder.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen7.text: That’s what you do to me.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen8.text: She leans in — her lips brushing the shell of his ear, barely a breath.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen9.text: (murmured) And I want to feel what I do to you.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen10.text: He exhales sharply, like her words just hit his spine. One hand moves to her lower back, pulling her flush against him. She doesn’t resist. Their bodies mold together like they were choreographed for this.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen13.text: She tilts her head, their mouths inches apart — and this time, he doesn’t stop himself. Their kiss isn’t soft. It’s consuming. Hungry. His mouth claims hers like he’s waited a lifetime. Her hands thread into his hair as he backs her toward the mirror, every step full of intention.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen14.text: Her back meets the glass. His hands slide along her sides, her waist, learning every inch like she’s an instrument he’s always meant to play. She arches into him, breath hitching. He lifts her slightly, and her legs wrap around his waist without hesitation.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen15.text: Their movements are fluid, feverish. Their rhythm is flawless. Their breath fogs the mirror behind her. Every sound — the catch in her throat, the low groan in his chest — hangs between them like notes in a symphony written just for two.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen16.text: Their bodies still pressed together. His forehead rests against hers. Their breathing slowly calms, but neither speaks.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen17.text: Lesley brushes her thumb over his jaw. She’s still trembling, but she doesn’t look away.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen18.text: (soft) If this was a mistake… I’d make it again.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen20.text: No curtain closes. No music swells. Just them. Entwined. Honest. And finally — unafraid.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen1.text: She steps back slightly — but keeps her fingers on his.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (quietly) This isn’t just… a dance anymore, is it?

scene6_choice1_option2_screen4.text: She smiles — a slow curve of something real.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen5.text: Then… maybe we should stop pretending it is.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen6.text: Their foreheads touch. Their hands stay clasped. They don’t kiss, but it’s written in every breath. They don’t need more. Not tonight. They’ve already begun something impossible to undo.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen1.text: She pulls away. Gently. Not with rejection — but with a kind of heartbreak.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen2.text: I wanted this. I still want this. But… I need to be sure it’s not just the room. The music. The moment.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen3.text: He watches her carefully. Doesn’t move. Doesn’t demand.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen5.text: (softly) I owe myself the space to know if this is real.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen6.text: She steps toward the door. Pauses. Looks back.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen7.text: (whisper) If you still want me after a few days… Ask me again.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen8.text: Then she’s gone — leaving only the echo of her steps and an elevated pulse racing through his veins.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen9.text: (to the mirror) I already know my answer.

scene6_screen12.text: They came together through rhythm, through fire, through everything unspoken. Whether they burn bright together or apart, they’ll never dance the same again. Discuss the sensory lessons of this story with your partner.
